description: This file defines interfaces, enums, classes, and constants related to Content Decryption Module (CDM) and Media Key Session management, including classes for BufferReader, IMediaKeySession, IMediaKeys, and related factory templates, primarily for handling encrypted media streams and DRM.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, supporting multi-byte reads, string, and vector extraction, with internal position tracking.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionCallback
classes.description: Interface for receiving events from a media key session, such as key messages, errors, and status updates.

classes.name: IMediaKeySession
classes.description: Interface representing a media key session, with methods for loading, updating, removing, closing, and decrypting media data.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media key sessions, including DRM header setting, challenge data handling, license storage, and key ID selection.

classes.name: IMediaKeys
classes.description: Interface for managing media keys, creating sessions, setting server certificates, and destroying sessions.

classes.name: IMediaKeysExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media keys, providing system time, version, secure stop management, and secure store operations.

classes.name: IMediaSystemMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media system metrics.

classes.name: IMediaSessionMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media session metrics.

classes.name: ISystemFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating media key system instances, retrieving key system info, and managing initialization.

classes.name: SystemFactoryType
classes.description: Template class implementing ISystemFactory for specific media key system implementations, with dynamic initialization and enable/disable capabilities.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Internal template method for reading multi-byte data types from buffer with endian correction.

methods.name: HasBytes
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has enough bytes remaining for a read.

methods.name: IsEOF
methods.description: Checks if the buffer position has reached the end.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Returns current read position in the buffer.

methods.name: Read1
methods.description: Reads a uint8_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read2
methods.description: Reads a uint16_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read2s
methods.description: Reads an int16_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read4
methods.description: Reads a uint32_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read4s
methods.description: Reads an int32_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read8
methods.description: Reads a uint64_t value from buffer.

methods.name: Read8s
methods.description: Reads an int64_t value from buffer.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string of specified length from buffer.

methods.name: ReadVec
methods.description: Reads a vector of bytes of specified length from buffer.

methods.name: Read4Into8
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte uint32_t and stores it into a uint64_t.

methods.name: Read4sInto8s
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte int32_t and stores it into an int64_t.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Advances the read position by specified bytes.

methods.name: CreateMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new media key session.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets server certificate for media keys.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the key session process with callback.

methods.name: IsSecureStopEnabled
methods.description: Checks if secure stop is enabled.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Retrieves media system or session metrics.
